product.name: Aurelio ChillPad X2
product.description: The Aurelio ChillPad X2 is a lightweight cooling pad designed for laptops ranging from 13 to 17 inches. Its dual‑fan system delivers a steady airflow of 1200 CFM, keeping devices cool during intensive tasks. The pad features a silicone‑coated surface for heat dissipation and a non‑slip rubber base to secure the laptop in place. A USB‑C power port supplies up to 45 W, allowing the pad to operate independently of the laptop’s power supply. The compact 35 cm × 25 cm footprint and 1.2 kg weight make it portable for travel and office use.
